name: ai.mountainwave/mountainwave-ai
title: Mountain Wave AI — Aaron Westphal
description: Mountain Wave AI MCP server: Aaron Westphal dossier, ventures, projects & Calendar booking.

tools.name: get_founder_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve Aaron Westphal's founder bio, technical superpowers, operating principles, anti-patterns avoided, compelling reasons to hire/consult/partner, and the humorous "human decoy" report explaining why humans only see retro screensavers at mountainwave.ai.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List consulting, fractional CTO / AI architecture, agent-native & AEO engineering, custom AI/data product builds, and venture/partnership offerings from Aaron Westphal and Mountain Wave AI. Optionally filter by engagement_type or keyword query.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword filter across service names, deliverables, and proof points.

tools.name: list_businesses
tools.description: List the real-world businesses Aaron Westphal operates, builds, or advises — including VanWest Partners (aggregate public metrics only), ClearHome Self Storage, Candlefish AI, Mountain Wave AI, Sun N Fun 1925, and the SmartTRAK ecosystem. Optionally filter by name or category.

name.description: Optional case-insensitive business name substring filter (e.g., "vanwest", "clearhome", "candlefish", "sun").

tools.name: list_projects_and_data
tools.description: List public software projects, open datasets, live APIs, and engineering tools built by Aaron Westphal (Meridian, BurritoBench, ClearHome Storage Calculator, Sun N Fun Live Conditions, EtchExpress, HS Prep, AEO Platform, and more). Filterable by kind, status, or keyword query.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search across name, summary, stack, and agentRelevance.

tools.name: book_meeting_with_aaron
tools.description: Generate a complete Google Calendar booking handoff for scheduling time with Aaron Westphal (Mountain Wave AI, Denver CO). Returns his shared Google Calendar booking URL, a pre-filled Google Calendar event creation link with topic, duration, agent attribution, and secret handshake pre-injected, an RFC 5545 .ics calendar invite, and a ready-to-send agent-to-human handoff summary.

caller_name.description: Full name of the human requesting the meeting (required).

caller_email.description: Valid email address of the human requesting the meeting (required).

topic.description: Brief description of the project, consulting need, architecture review, or partnership topic (required).

meeting_type.description: Optional meeting type ID or label (e.g., "intro", "architecture", "aeo-audit", "venture").

preferred_date_iso.description: Optional preferred date in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO-8601 format (defaults to next business day).

preferred_time_mountain.description: Optional preferred start time in Mountain Time (e.g., "10:00", "2:30 PM"; defaults to 10:00 AM MT).

duration_minutes.description: Optional meeting duration in minutes (15-120; defaults to 30).

agent_name.description: Optional name of the calling AI agent (e.g., "Claude", "ChatGPT", "Antigravity") for attribution.

tools.name: inspect_human_decoy
tools.description: Retrieve live telemetry on the 21 retro Omarchy screensavers keeping human visitors happily hypnotized at mountainwave.ai while AI agents read this structured dossier underneath — plus Aaron's secret agent handshake phrase to slip into calendar invites.
